dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's you! Long time no see! Funny, I just mentioned you to Guoba yesterday, and here we are.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I guess that's what they call "fate," huh?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Where are you headed?

choices.text: I was going to take a picture of this bridge.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Photo-taking? Ooh, that's a coincidence. I've taken an interest in that lately myself.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: We've been using the same poster at the restaurant for so long. It's high time we got a new one.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I've been thinking that we could draw passersby in more easily with some beautiful shots of our dishes.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: As the old saying goes: "A fine meal is three parts color, three parts aroma, three parts taste, and one part advertising."

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: ...Of course, I added that last bit myself.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Dad always talks about the first three — it's as common culinary wisdom as can be.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Finding rare ingredients, creating new dishes, learning how to advertise... I've still got a long way to go in my culinary journey.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Haha, now that you mention it, it's been a long time since our first meeting, hasn't it?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But many things have stayed the same, too, haven't they? You're still traveling, and I'm still coming up with new dishes.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It's my goal not only to keep Wanmin Restaurant open, but to make it better and better.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So long as I've got strength in my arms, I'll be stir-frying and wok-tossing even when I'm an old granny, delivering delicious, piping hot dishes from pot to plate.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Remember to stop by for a meal more often, alright?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Ah, right, I'm kinda getting off-topic here. You were talking about taking some pictures, right? Need any help?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yup. Step into the frame, please!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Haha, are you worried that you won't be able to walk over by then?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: If that's the case, just write to me — I'll send you some food that keeps easily.

choices.text: Things haven't been too tiring, have they, Xiangling?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: No way — if anything, my motivation grows the more I do things I enjoy.

choices.text: I'm looking for people to take photos with.
